runtime_contract.weight_uploads: once at initialization, all 32 experts in all 24 layers
runtime_contract.request: token ID and position enter west; all neural operands remain on wafer
runtime_contract.expert_dispatch: broadcast activation plus top-4 mask; only selected experts compute
runtime_contract.expert_join: four distinct selected expert results per output tile and request epoch
runtime_contract.output: east-side vocabulary projection and greedy token selection; D2H at east edge
runtime_contract.persistent_state: all parameters plus per-layer KV caches survive request release

remaining_gates: all role ELF sections and dynamic buffer/stack bounds
complete attention and expert transpose/reduction routes
on-wafer all-layer continuous generation and numerical comparison
